Name: Nyapu's Haley Portrait edits for Haley's Pregnancy
Author: cptnmatruz
Description:
[size=4]With Nyapu's permission, I've created these Haley's portrait edits to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17206]Haley's Pregnancy[/url].

To use them:
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=4]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17206]Haley's Pregnancy[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this mod[/size]
[*][size=4]Unzip in ../Stardew Valley/Mods, overwrite the folder inside with the same name folder of the original mod.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Credits:[/size][/b]
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url]﻿[/size][size=4] - Original art by Nyapu

Thank you so much for letting me share these!
[/size]
[size=5]*** NOTE: For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/4332]Acastus and Penelope's portraits[/url] (who were introduced in version 1.0.0 of Haley's Pregnancy), I've requested [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt?gameId=1303]AhCuteArt[/url] to make them, thank you!. ***[/size]

Downloads.Description:
To install:
1. Download and install "Haley's Pregnancy"
2. Unzip this mod in ../Stardew Valley/Mods
